simple.summary: גִּלֹה (Gilôh) means Giloh , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 2Sam 15 12.

definitions.full: H1542. Giloh גִּלֹה proper name, of a location city in mountains of Judah Josh 15:51 ; 2Sam 15:12 ; (on v compare Dr 15:12 .) גִּלֹה proper name, of a location see below גיל . גֻּלָּה see below גלל .
